label: FBBP private formal dataset April 2026
notes: Canonical formal descriptor for the real FBBP runtime used by MCP, DeerFlow, and formal acceptance flows.

formal_snapshot.notes: Runtime and explicit formal rebuilds use this repo-local fixed snapshot. Sync from llm-rag-knowledge-base only through the dedicated snapshot refresh command.

rebuild.notes: Default smoke and acceptance reuse the prepared formal DB. Explicit rebuild commands rebuild from the repo-local formal snapshot; use the dedicated sync command if you want to refresh that snapshot from the canonical llm-rag-knowledge-base exports.

raw_records.jsonl.source_description: Full-table FBBP raw record export used to preserve per-table provenance during retrieval.
raw_records.jsonl.quality_notes: Canonical formal export covering all normalized FBBP tables.

protein_cards_v2.jsonl.source_description: Protein-level synthesized cards for the v2 FBBP formal build.
protein_cards_v2.jsonl.quality_notes: Use for high-level protein summaries; underlying evidence should still be traced to table rows when possible.

interaction_cards_v2.jsonl.source_description: Interaction-level synthesized cards for the v2 FBBP formal build.
interaction_cards_v2.jsonl.quality_notes: Use for high-level interaction summaries; underlying evidence should still be traced to table rows when possible.

affinity_data.csv.source_description: Affinity assay rows attached to interaction identifiers.
affinity_data.csv.quality_notes: Measured binding values with method and unit context.

bcell_epitope_results.csv.source_description: B-cell epitope predictions and supporting sequence-level annotations.
bcell_epitope_results.csv.quality_notes: Sequence-derived computational result table; interpret alongside model assumptions.

cmc_data.csv.quality_notes: Formal developability table linked through domain identifiers.

developability_results.csv.source_description: Integrated developability summary outputs for FBBP proteins.
developability_results.csv.quality_notes: Aggregate computational assessment; review together with source component tables.

digestive_assays.csv.source_description: Digestive stability assay outcomes linked to domains.
digestive_assays.csv.quality_notes: Experimental assay rows with limited coverage relative to the full corpus.

domains.csv.source_description: Canonical domain registry connecting proteins, sources, and structures.
domains.csv.quality_notes: Core join table for domain-centric retrieval.

ecoli_expression_results.csv.source_description: E. coli expression outputs for FBBP proteins.
ecoli_expression_results.csv.quality_notes: Experimental expression readout; coverage is narrower than the full protein table.

foldseek_results.csv.quality_notes: Structure-search results; interpret together with rank and template context.

functional_annotations.csv.source_description: Functional annotations linked to protein identifiers.
functional_annotations.csv.quality_notes: Curated or normalized function notes with partial coverage.

immunogenicity_summary.csv.source_description: Integrated immunogenicity summary rows for proteins.
immunogenicity_summary.csv.quality_notes: Summary layer that should be checked against constituent immunogenicity tables for exact evidence.

interactions.csv.source_description: Canonical interaction table linking domains, targets, and sources.
interactions.csv.quality_notes: Primary interaction anchor table for downstream affinity and source joins.

loop_annotations.csv.source_description: Loop annotation outputs keyed by protein row identifiers.
loop_annotations.csv.quality_notes: Computational loop-annotation table used in provenance-focused reviews.

loop_flexibility_results.csv.source_description: Loop flexibility estimates for protein rows.
loop_flexibility_results.csv.quality_notes: Computational flexibility outputs intended for structural interpretation, not direct experimental claims.

manual_review_audit.csv.source_description: Manual audit trace rows for curated FBBP entries.
manual_review_audit.csv.quality_notes: Audit trail table supporting provenance and QC review.

mhci_results.csv.source_description: MHC-I presentation predictions for protein rows.
mhci_results.csv.quality_notes: Model-derived immunogenicity signal; compare with companion tables for consistency.

mhcii_results.csv.source_description: MHC-II presentation predictions for protein rows.
mhcii_results.csv.quality_notes: Model-derived immunogenicity signal; compare with companion tables for consistency.

oral_results.csv.quality_notes: Derived developability signal that should be interpreted together with assay and CMC tables.

pipeline_versions.csv.source_description: Pipeline version manifest for the formal FBBP build.
pipeline_versions.csv.quality_notes: Build metadata table for traceability rather than biological evidence.

plmsearch_results.csv.source_description: Protein language model similarity search outputs for protein rows.
plmsearch_results.csv.quality_notes: High-volume computational retrieval table frequently used in provenance inspection.

protein_flexibility_summary.csv.source_description: Protein-level flexibility summaries derived from structural analyses.
protein_flexibility_summary.csv.quality_notes: Summary table for flexibility interpretation; use constituent evidence for exact details.

protein_identifiers.csv.source_description: Alternative identifier mapping table for proteins.
protein_identifiers.csv.quality_notes: Useful for alias resolution and entity normalization.

proteins.csv.source_description: Canonical protein entity table for the FBBP corpus.
proteins.csv.quality_notes: Primary protein registry table used by many joins.

protrek_results.csv.source_description: ProtTrek-style retrieval outputs for protein rows.
protrek_results.csv.quality_notes: Computational retrieval result table; interpret with model and ranking context.

result_metadata.csv.source_description: Run-level metadata for generated result tables.
result_metadata.csv.quality_notes: Operational metadata table supporting build reproducibility.

sources.csv.source_description: Canonical publication and citation source registry.
sources.csv.quality_notes: Primary provenance table for title, identifier, and publication date.

structural_info.csv.source_description: Structural reference and quality rows linked to domains.
structural_info.csv.quality_notes: Structure-centric evidence table for exact structural identifiers and metrics.

structure_refinement_history.csv.source_description: Refinement history rows for structure-related protein entries.
structure_refinement_history.csv.quality_notes: Operational structural refinement trail rather than direct biological effect evidence.

target_species_variants.csv.quality_notes: Target disambiguation table for interaction-level reasoning.

targets_conceptual.csv.source_description: Conceptual target registry for shared target identities.
targets_conceptual.csv.quality_notes: Use with target species variants for precise target interpretation.

ted_results.csv.source_description: TED retrieval outputs for protein rows.
ted_results.csv.quality_notes: Computational retrieval result table with model-dependent ranking.

trusted_source_qc.csv.source_description: Trusted-source QC summary for protein rows.
trusted_source_qc.csv.quality_notes: Quality-control table meant to support formal acceptance and provenance screening.
